为什么那声音夜里还响个不停？
persistence: Her persistence got the ball out of the tree.
靠着一股坚持劲儿，她把球从树上弄了下来。
小蜘蛛，你可真会坚持呀！
perspective: A tree house gives a new perspective!
树屋能带来全新的视角！
Did you draw the house from a bird's perspective?
你是按照小鸟的视角画的那座房子吗？
Draw the tree from a worm's perspective!
按照小虫子的视角来画这棵树吧！
persuasion: He used persuasion to get another cookie.
他软磨硬泡，又拿到了一块饼干。
Did your persuasion work on your grandmother?
你那套说辞对奶奶管用吗？
带着微笑去说服别人吧！
pertinacity: With pertinacity, the snail got to the leaf.
靠着顽强的劲儿，小蜗牛终于爬到了叶子那儿。
Do you have the pertinacity of a bee?
你有小蜜蜂那股顽强劲儿吗？
perturbation: The rock made a perturbation in the pond.
石头让池塘的水面起了一阵波动。
Did you see that perturbation in the water?
你看见水里那阵波动了吗？
What a big perturbation from a little fish!
一条小鱼竟能搅起这么大的波动！
pesticide: The farmer uses pesticide on the corn.
农民在玉米上使用杀虫剂。
What does pesticide do to the bugs?
杀虫剂对虫子有什么作用呢？
Pesticide keeps the bugs off the peas!
杀虫剂能让虫子不啃豌豆！
petrified: He was petrified when he saw the big spider.
看到那只大蜘蛛，他吓得呆住了。
你是不是特别特别怕蜘蛛？
The old tree turned into petrified rock!
那棵老树变成了硬邦邦的石头！
petrochemical: Many things in our house are petrochemical.
我们家里的许多东西都是石化制品。
Is my new water bottle petrochemical?
我的新水瓶是石化材料做的吗？
So many petrochemical things in one room!
一个房间里竟有这么多石化制品！
petroleum: Petroleum is black and comes from under the dirt.
石油黑黑的，藏在地底下的土里。
Do airplanes need petroleum to fly?
Wow, so many things are made from petroleum!
哇，有好多好多东西都是用石油做的！
phantasmal: The old house looked phantasmal at night.
夜里，那座老房子看起来像幻影一样。
那是一场虚幻缥缈的梦吗？
What a phantasmal white bird at the window!
窗前那只白色的鸟真像幻影呀！
phenomenon: A rainbow is a colorful phenomenon.
彩虹是一种色彩缤纷的现象。
What phenomenon did you see today?
今天你看到了什么现象呀？
What a cool phenomenon in the night sky!
夜空里的这个现象真酷呀！
pheromone: Bees use a pheromone to find their home.
蜜蜂靠信息素找到回家的路。
什么动物会使用信息素呢？
The pheromone tells other bees where food is!
信息素会告诉其他蜜蜂食物在哪儿！
philippic: The old story has a long philippic in it.
这个老故事里有一大段长长的抨击演说。
Was the philippic in today's story?
那段抨击演说是在今天的故事里吗？
What a philippic my grandfather gave!
爷爷刚才那一番抨击讲得可真厉害！
phonics: We do phonics at school every day.
我们每天在学校学自然拼读。
自然拼读对你来说有趣吗？
Let's do phonics with the new book!
咱们用新书来练自然拼读吧！
phonogram: We write the phonogram on the paper.
A new phonogram makes reading fun!
学一个新字组，让阅读更有趣！
phonologic: Phonologic games help us read new words.
语音小游戏能帮我们读出新单词。
多有趣的一首语音歌谣呀！
photograph: My father takes a photograph of our family.
爸爸给我们全家拍了张照片。
Can I see the photograph from the picnic?
我能看看野餐时拍的照片吗？
physician: The physician says I am fine.
When do we see the physician?
我们什么时候去看医师呀？
The physician helped my grandmother walk again!
医师让我奶奶又能走路了！
physics: My brother reads books about physics.
我哥哥读关于物理的书。
Physics tells us why the kite flies!
物理告诉我们风筝为什么会飞！
physiology: Physiology tells us about the body.
生理学给我们讲身体的知识。
多么有趣的一本生理学书呀！
phytoplankton: Phytoplankton are very little ocean plants.
浮游植物是很小很小的海洋植物。
什么动物吃浮游植物呢？
The whale eats a lot of phytoplankton!
鲸鱼要吃掉好多好多浮游植物！
pi: Pi is a very long number.
圆周率是一个很长很长的数。
Do you know the number pi?
你知道圆周率这个数吗？
piazza: We eat cookies on the warm piazza.
我们在暖洋洋的广场上吃饼干。
So many people are on the piazza!
pictograph: We made a pictograph of our apples.
我们做了一个关于苹果的象形统计图。
象形统计图上说了什么呀？
Draw a pictograph of our snack days.
画一张零食日的象形统计图吧！
